entries.text: 你傻啊，我有个好办法，就是把他关到牢里让他慢慢烂掉，或者干脆流放，不给吃，不给穿，更不给武器。
entries.source_text: 你傻啊，我有个好办法，就是把他关到牢里让他慢慢烂掉，或者干脆流放，不给吃，不给穿，更不给武器。

entries.text: That still doesn't justify the way you're treating him!
entries.source_text: That still doesn't justify the way you're treating him!

entries.text: 就是这样的话，你也不能这样对他。
entries.source_text: 就是这样的话，你也不能这样对他。

entries.text: Oh, okay.
entries.source_text: Oh, okay.

entries.text: 噢，好的。
entries.source_text: 噢，好的。

entries.text: I may not be the best role model in this damn city, but I'm the only# one who cares and is willing ta try to help.  What have ya' done to improve society?
entries.source_text:
I may not be the best role model in this damn city, but I'm the only
# one who cares and is willing ta try to help.  What have ya' done to improve society?

entries.text: 我也许不是这遭瘟的城里最好的家伙，但我是这儿唯一一个会关心别人而且愿意提供帮助的人。你有为这个社会做过什么事没？
entries.source_text: 我也许不是这遭瘟的城里最好的家伙，但我是这儿唯一一个会关心别人而且愿意提供帮助的人。你有为这个社会做过什么事没？

entries.text: I've killed lots of things!
entries.source_text: I've killed lots of things!

entries.text: 我杀了好多好多东西！
entries.source_text: 我杀了好多好多东西！

entries.text: I'm sorry, I've misjudged you.
entries.source_text: I'm sorry, I've misjudged you.

entries.text: 我很抱歉，我错怪你了。
entries.source_text: 我很抱歉，我错怪你了。

entries.text: You should have just killed the brat!
entries.source_text: You should have just killed the brat!

entries.text: 你该杀了那个小混蛋！
entries.source_text: 你该杀了那个小混蛋！

entries.text: Well, maybe you could be just a little nicer to him.  I think he's trying.
entries.source_text: Well, maybe you could be just a little nicer to him.  I think he's trying.

entries.text: 嗯，那你也许能对他稍微和气一点。我想他在努力改正了。
entries.source_text: 嗯，那你也许能对他稍微和气一点。我想他在努力改正了。

entries.text: You should give him a good whipping!
entries.source_text: You should give him a good whipping!

entries.text: 你该赏他一顿鞭子！
entries.source_text: 你该赏他一顿鞭子！

entries.text: Ya' think killing people solves the real problem?
entries.source_text: Ya' think killing people solves the real problem?

entries.text: 你认为杀人就能解决问题了？
entries.source_text: 你认为杀人就能解决问题了？

entries.text: Yep!
entries.source_text: Yep!

entries.text: 没错！
entries.source_text: 没错！

entries.text: It's been working for me so far!
entries.source_text: It's been working for me so far!

entries.text: 这对我来说一直很有效！
entries.source_text: 这对我来说一直很有效！

entries.text: Hmmm, maybe not.
entries.source_text: Hmmm, maybe not.

entries.text: 唔，也许不是哦。
entries.source_text: 唔，也许不是哦。

entries.text: I don't know.
entries.source_text: I don't know.

entries.text: 我不知道。
entries.source_text: 我不知道。

entries.text: You disappoint me. You seemed to have a good head on your shoulders.# Killing them might get rid of the problem temporarily, but you've got to# get at the root of the problem to really make a difference.
entries.source_text:
You disappoint me. You seemed to have a good head on your shoulders.
# Killing them might get rid of the problem temporarily, but you've got to
# get at the root of the problem to really make a difference.

entries.text: 你让我失望了。你肩膀上的脑袋看上去倒是挺聪明。杀人，也许可以解决一时的问题，但是却让这个问题从本质上变得完全不同了。
entries.source_text: 你让我失望了。你肩膀上的脑袋看上去倒是挺聪明。杀人，也许可以解决一时的问题，但是却让这个问题从本质上变得完全不同了。

entries.text: Yeah, whatever.
entries.source_text: Yeah, whatever.

entries.text: 是啊，随便啦。
entries.source_text: 是啊，随便啦。

entries.text: Uh, okay. Bye.
entries.source_text: Uh, okay. Bye.

entries.text: 呃，好。拜拜。
entries.source_text: 呃，好。拜拜。

entries.text: You're an idiot.
entries.source_text: You're an idiot.

entries.text: 你这个白痴。
entries.source_text: 你这个白痴。

entries.text: Well (he pauses looking off into space) . . . maybe yer right, partner. # I'll keep that in mind but I ain't promisin' ya' anything.
entries.source_text:
Well (he pauses looking off into space) . . . maybe yer right, partner.
 # I'll keep that in mind but I ain't promisin' ya' anything.

entries.text: 嗯，【他停下来往四周看了看】……也许你是对的，伙计。我会考虑的，但是我不敢保证。
entries.source_text: 嗯，【他停下来往四周看了看】……也许你是对的，伙计。我会考虑的，但是我不敢保证。

entries.text: Are ya' kiddin'? That'd just make'm more defiant! My ways may not be # perfect but at least I know it'll make'm stronger and more responsible.
entries.source_text:
Are ya' kiddin'? That'd just make'm more defiant! My ways may not be
 # perfect but at least I know it'll make'm stronger and more responsible.

entries.text: 你在开玩笑吧？那只会让我更加目空一切！我的方法或许不是最好的，但至少这可以让我变得更强，更有责任感。
entries.source_text: 你在开玩笑吧？那只会让我更加目空一切！我的方法或许不是最好的，但至少这可以让我变得更强，更有责任感。

entries.text: Damn straight. Kill'n the person with the disease isn't the best way. # You've gotta find the cure because it's bound to surface again.
entries.source_text:
Damn straight. Kill'n the person with the disease isn't the best way.
 # You've gotta find the cure because it's bound to surface again.

entries.text: 该死，把得病的人杀了不是最好的办法。你肯定能找到治好他们的方法，因为它就要再次出现了。

entries.text: No kidding, Einstein.
entries.source_text: No kidding, Einstein.

entries.text: 别开玩笑了，你以为你是爱因斯坦啊。
entries.source_text: 别开玩笑了，你以为你是爱因斯坦啊。

entries.text: Quit yer' yappin'! You're giving me a headache!
entries.source_text: Quit yer' yappin'! You're giving me a headache!

entries.text: 少废话了，我头都疼了！
entries.source_text: 少废话了，我头都疼了！

entries.text: Uh, yeah, sure pal. I've gotta go.
entries.source_text: Uh, yeah, sure pal. I've gotta go.

entries.text: 呃，是啊，没错，伙计。我得走了。
entries.source_text: 呃，是啊，没错，伙计。我得走了。

entries.text: Well, try not ta solve all yer problems with a gun. Bye.
entries.source_text: Well, try not ta solve all yer problems with a gun. Bye.

entries.text: 嗯，别总用枪解决问题。再见。
entries.source_text: 嗯，别总用枪解决问题。再见。

entries.text: Damn, it's hot today!
entries.source_text: Damn, it's hot today!

entries.text: 妈的，真热！
entries.source_text: 妈的，真热！

entries.text: Billy! Ya' better not be screw'n around, ya' little shit!
entries.source_text: Billy! Ya' better not be screw'n around, ya' little shit!

entries.text: 比利！别在那游手好闲的，你这个垃圾！
entries.source_text: 比利！别在那游手好闲的，你这个垃圾！

entries.text: Billy! Ya' better make sure those brahmin are kept warm tonight or# it'll be yer hide!
entries.source_text:
Billy! Ya' better make sure those brahmin are kept warm tonight or
# it'll be yer hide!

entries.text: 比利！你今晚最好让那些双头牛保持温暖，不然剥了你的皮！
entries.source_text: 比利！你今晚最好让那些双头牛保持温暖，不然剥了你的皮！

entries.text: Damn it, you little brat! Stop yappin' and start working!
entries.source_text: Damn it, you little brat! Stop yappin' and start working!

entries.text: 该死，你这个小混蛋！闭上你的狗嘴干活去！
entries.source_text: 该死，你这个小混蛋！闭上你的狗嘴干活去！

entries.text: 我跟你说了，不要游手好闲的！
entries.source_text: 我跟你说了，不要游手好闲的！

entries.text: I'm warning you, Billy!
entries.source_text: I'm warning you, Billy!

entries.source_text: 我警告你，比利！

entries.text: You don't want the hard way, do you?
entries.source_text: You don't want the hard way, do you?

entries.text: 你不是敬酒不吃吃罚酒吧？

entries.text: 要工作的话跟那些商人说。我这里不招人。

entries.text: I said get out! I'm not joke'n!  I'll blow yer frigg'n head off!
